name: Order ticket · buy/sell · live estimate II
tags: order-entry, ticket, buy-sell, limit, market, segmented-control, estimate, form
note: Equity order pad. tags: order-book, depth, level-2, ladder, bids, asks, spread, hover-readout
note: Eight-level BTC ladder. Each row is a real button so the ladder is keyboard-walkable, and the depth shade is an absolutely positioned bar whose width comes from a --trd-db-d custom property set from cumulative size, animated with a width transition. Hovering or focusing a row swaps the header for a take readout of cumulative size at that price; clicking pins the level and the readout keeps tracking it. tags: position, pnl, unrealised, perp, sparkline, svg, mark-price, liquidation
note: Perp position with a live mark. The unrealised figure carries an arrow glyph and an explicit plus or minus sign so direction survives greyscale, and data-dir on the root swaps the accent used by the number, the percentage, the glow and the sparkline stroke. name: Market status pill · countdown to open II
tags: market-hours, session, countdown, pre-market, after-hours, timezone, status-pill, timer
note: A real US equity session clock with no library: Intl.DateTimeFormat resolves the current wall time in America/New_York, and the component classifies it into closed, pre-market, open or after-hours against 04:00, 09:30, 16:00 and 20:00, rolling weekends forward to Monday. data-state on the root drives the pill colour and the dot pulse (which only runs while the market is open), the label flips between Opens in and Closes in, and the 04:00 to 20:00 rail marks the regular session band with a live now-marker. Exchange holidays are not modelled.

name: One-click close · armed confirm
tags: confirm, destructive-action, two-step, countdown, escape-key, focus-management, close-position
note: Guarded close for an open perp. The single button arms a confirm strip that disarms itself after four seconds, tracked against a wall-clock deadline (not accumulated ticks) so a backgrounded tab with throttled timers cannot silently stretch the window. Focus moves to the confirm button when armed and Escape disarms it, then a working stage settles into a realised P&L line; every stage is announced through one role="status" element and the whole flow is driven by data-stage on the root.
